statements.quote: The big step up in capex both year- over-year and sequentially related to server spend, including for our AI infrastructure.
statements.notes: Attributes the capex increase partly to AI infrastructure server spend without quantifying it. The period is the quarter ended 2022-06-30, not the full fiscal year. The $7.7B quarterly capex figure in the preceding sentence is not linked to AI, so it was not recorded. The 2022 guidance of $30-34B in p02 does not mention AI, so it was also not recorded.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses (R&D, infrastructure costs, headcount) to AI
